reviews.author: serene
reviews.text: Great coffee (and it comes with a free donut, yum!). Chic decor and friendly staff. Checked all the boxes and more. Be sure to visit the textile gallery next door!

reviews.author: Rashed A.
reviews.text: Best Karak tea, and also best flat white coffee

reviews.author: Fahad A.
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere. Love their coffee 💙 located at Sadu House. It has a unique vibe. Instagram @fahadtrips

reviews.author: Talal A.
reviews.text: Roastry one fine Cafe, located inside Bait Albader (Historical landmark) the atmosphere is so cozy and beautiful highly recommended for a coffee break in the middle of the day, idol for having a friend gathering. Coffee and espresso and much more for quite menu with…
